# record-dedupe

> Find duplicate records with weighted fuzzy field rules: Jaro-Winkler, Levenshtein, exact and numeric tolerance, blocking keys, union-find clusters and survivorship merge Python package `trysac-record-dedupe`, import name `record_dedupe`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
